exposure: Bilateral tubal ligation (BTL) using the Vaginal Natural Orifice Transluminal Endoscopic Surgery (v-NOTES) method
cohort: The study included 164 patients with a mean age of 38.4 years who underwent bilateral tubal ligation for permanent sterilization using the v-NOTES method.
finding: Bilateral tubal ligation performed with the v-NOTES technique demonstrated an overall intraoperative complication rate of 2.4%, a 1.2% conversion rate to conventional laparoscopy, a median hospital stay of 1 day, and very low postoperative pain scores.
